summary:
Judge B whole-graph wiring recall DONE. Worktree: /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/worktrees/62dae274979b8432/091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee-15 | branch: orch/attempt/091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee-15 | commit 7e29558.

Added autowireNewTaskWholeGraph (daemon.js), called from routes/overlay.js /overlay/status right after a new task's FIRST embedding is set (guarded on !_hasVec). On task creation it runs scoreMatchesSemantic over the WHOLE graph and seeds weight-0, judged:false candidate edges to BOTH kinds: NOTES (note is provider, note->anchor — mirrors autowireNoteProvider) and TASKS (anchor is provider, anchor->task so the task-A neighborhood judge classifies taskTask=true and runs the kind/dup path). Done tasks are eligible providers. Edges carry by:autowire, origin:autowire-semantic, cosine in score — retrieval-invisible until the judge promotes them, surface on /judge/next. Semantic only (no lexical), gated at SEMANTIC_AUTOWIRE_THRESHOLD 0.55, per-kind fan-out cap 5. Closes the double gap: lexical task->task autowire removed (task /5) AND note->task only fired on note creation, never task creation — a new task previously got NEITHER candidate kind.

Test: test/autowire-newtask-wholegraph.test.js, 19/19 pass (both kinds wired, correct directions, weight-0/judged:false/autowire-semantic, done-provider eligible, NO lexical edge, idempotent, fan-out capped). Full suite: 92/106 files; the 14 failures are pre-existing sandbox port-binding/daemon-spin tests — confirmed identical via git-stash on clean HEAD (zero new failures). routes/classify.js untouched.

GATE FRICTION (report): MCP start_task still REJECTED this session as a dispatcher even after the 5161f39 fix. Fallback chain needed: POST /agent/start with parent_session_id===session_id (sets agent_tool_spawn=true) + POST /overlay/claim-session + POST /overlay/status in_progress (which accepts via the agent_tool_spawn arm). The MCP start_task arm itself never accepted the dispatcher session.

subject: Judge B: whole-graph wiring recall — propose task→task candidate edges, not just task→note
description:
At wiring time, semantic RAG recall must span the WHOLE graph (notes AND tasks), so an anchor task gets candidate edges to relevant existing TASKS as well as notes — all fed to the judge (task A). Part of the eager-judgment-lifecycle redesign.

This is the PRINCIPLED re-introduction of task→task wiring. Task /5 removed LEXICAL task→task autowire specifically because it had no agent in its lifecycle (never judged). Now tasks carry embeddings (task /7, Step 0), so task→task candidates come from SEMANTIC recall and go through neighborhood-aware JUDGMENT (task A) — an agent fully in the loop. Step /7's task embeddings are the recall substrate for exactly this.

DO:
1. At wiring (autowireNoteProvider's sibling path / the recall that feeds /judge/next), include TASK nodes as candidate providers/consumers for a new anchor task, scored by the same semantic max-cosine over vecs[]. Seed candidate edges at weight 0, by:'autowire', judged:false (existing weight-0 contract) so they are invisible until judged.
2. Do NOT resurrect the lexical scorer for this (Step 1 proved fusion regresses; semantic is the strong signal for recall). Lexical scoreMatches stays only for suggest_links.
3. The judge (task A) then adjudicates these task→task candidates with kind/dup classification.

TEST: a new task semantically near an existing task gets a weight-0 unjudged candidate edge that surfaces on /judge/next; it stays retrieval-invisible until judged; no lexical autowire returns.

GUARDRAIL: surgical; reuse the note-provider recall machinery. Daemon restart to go live (note, do not restart — gated).
